title: [FATAL] Potential race-condition between compactions and snapshots ends up deleting newly compacted file
body:
Found a FATAL file in one of our nightly CI/CD:
```
Log file created at: 2019/02/24 03:09:26
Running on machine: yb-itest-gsched-41cd20bbd3-20190224-024500-n6
Log line format: [IWEF]mmdd hh:mm:ss.uuuuuu threadid file:line] msg
F0224 03:09:26.893852 17162 tablet.cc:784] T 2b5727ace0d54e149ef9eb301bbf8fd0 P d29455d77b8a407aaa0a6841dd6c5861: Failed to write a batch with 1 operations into RocksDB: IO error (yb/rocksdb/util/env_posix.cc:191): /mnt/d0/yb-data/tserver/data/rocksdb/table-7f8087b55d8c4cccbe03fb097532c484/tablet-2b5727ace0d54e149ef9eb301bbf8fd0/000021.sst: No such file or directory
```

Seems like the RemoteBootstrap process ends up checkpointing RocksDB, which ends up conflicting with a concurrent compaction.

Starting the RB process:
```
1204 I0224 03:09:22.540403 17113 remote_bootstrap_service.cc:161] Beginning new remote bootstrap session on tablet 2b5727ace0d54e149ef9eb301bbf8fd0 from peer 67dd5219abfa451289d45e611b98f752 at 10.204.0.78:43188: session id = 67dd5219abfa451289d45e611b98f752-2b5727ace0d54e149ef9eb301bbf8fd0-493.942s
```

Compaction generating `21.sst`:
```
I0224 03:09:22.547974 17126 compaction_job.cc:909] T 2b5727ace0d54e149ef9eb301bbf8fd0: [default] [JOB 3] Generated table #21: 1677 keys, 102458 bytes
```

Potential concurrency issues between bootstrap's checkpoint ending and compaction ending, leading to the checkpoint cleanup removing the compaction output file (`21.sst`):
